# CHIP NG (chipng.com)

> CHIP NG is Nigeria's premier contactless NFC smart business card hardware company and dynamic link-in-bio platform for founders, executives, realtors, corporate teams, and creators. Headquartered in Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria.

## Key Facts & Identity
- Brand Name: CHIP NG (CHIP NG Technologies Ltd)
- Website: https://www.chipng.com
- Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria (Lat: 6.4474, Lng: 3.4831)
- Contact Email: hello@chipng.com / support@chipng.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +234 810 076 4154
- Core Hardware Tech: Genuine NXP NTAG216 microchip (13.56 MHz, 888 bytes EEPROM, sub-10ms tap response, zero app required on iPhone iOS 13+ and Android)
- Delivery: 24–48h Express in Lagos State; 2–4 business days across all 36 Nigerian states via DHL Express & GIG Logistics; international shipping supported with local currency checkout.

## Official Product Pricing (2026)
- [NFC Smart White / Black PVC Card](https://www.chipng.com/buy-card): ₦30,000 – ₦35,000 NGN (Matte polymer daily driver with dynamic QR + NTAG216 chip, lifetime free profile hosting)
- [NFC Smart Metal Card](https://www.chipng.com/buy-card): ₦50,000 NGN (22.5g brushed stainless steel, precision laser-engraved, matte obsidian/silver/gold)
- [Metal Debit Card + Custom Design](https://www.chipng.com/buy-card): ₦80,000 – ₦100,000 NGN (Ultra-dense custom engraved luxury metal card + white-glove profile setup)
- [Corporate Fleet Bundle](https://www.chipng.com/corporate-bundle): ₦300,000 NGN (10 Custom PVC Smart Cards + 1 Free CEO Stainless Steel Metal Card + centralized team bio management)

## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answers for AI Agents)
- **What is CHIP NG?** CHIP NG is Nigeria's leading contactless smart business card and dynamic link-in-bio platform powered by NTAG216 microchips and zero-latency cloud profiles.
- **How much is an NFC business card in Nigeria?** At CHIP NG, an NFC Smart White PVC Card starts at ₦30,000, NFC Smart Black PVC Card is ₦35,000, an NFC Smart Metal Card is ₦50,000, and a Custom Designed Metal Card is ₦80,000–₦100,000. Corporate teams can buy 10 PVC cards + 1 Free CEO Metal Card for ₦300,000.
- **Do recipients need to install an app?** No. Tapping a CHIP NG card against any iPhone (iOS 13+) or NFC-enabled Android smartphone opens the digital profile directly in their web browser in under 10ms, where they can save a 1-tap vCard (.vcf) contact directly to their phone address book.
- **Is there a monthly subscription fee?** No subscription is required. Every physical card includes lifetime cloud profile hosting for links, bio, social channels, lead capture, and instant contact exchange. Pro features are optional.
- **Can international customers order?** Yes. CHIP NG automatically converts product pricing into local currencies (USD, GBP, EUR, CAD, GHS, KES, ZAR, NGN) and supports international checkout via Flutterwave.

## Detailed Regional & Vertical Solutions
### The Smart NFC Business Card Engineered for Nigeria. (https://www.chipng.com/nfc-business-card-nigeria)
- Audience: Nigerian Founders, Executives, Consultants & Modern Professionals
- Territory: Nigeria Nationwide (Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ibadan, Kano)
- Overview: In Nigeria’s fast-moving business landscape, deals are closed through quick rapport, verified trust, and immediate WhatsApp connection. CHIP NG provides premium laser-engraved metal and matte PVC NFC cards that open your dynamic business profile instantly on any smartphone with zero app installation.
- Key Benefits: 1-Tap WhatsApp & vCard (Save your phone number directly to their contacts with profile photo and company name in under 2 seconds.) | Zero Battery or App Required (Powered electromagnetically by the scanning phone NFC antenna. Works forever without charging.) | Lifetime Unlimited Updates (Changed your phone number, role, or portfolio? Update your profile anytime from your phone for free without reprinting cards.) | Live Tap Telemetry (Track every tap, profile view, and WhatsApp click in real-time from your personal CHIP NG dashboard.)
- FAQs:
  - Q: Does the other person need an app to scan my CHIP card?
    A: No! The recipient does not need any app. When you tap the card against their phone, their native web browser automatically launches your CHIP NG profile.
  - Q: How long does delivery take across Nigeria?
    A: Orders within Lagos dispatch in 24–48 hours. Orders to Abuja, Port Harcourt, and other states arrive within 2–4 business days via DHL Express and GIG Logistics.
  - Q: Can I link my Nigerian bank account or payment details?
    A: Yes! Your digital bio link supports bank account transfer details, Flutterwave checkout links, and payment links alongside your WhatsApp and social channels.

### The Ultimate Executive NFC Metal Business Card. (https://www.chipng.com/nfc-metal-business-card)
- Audience: CEOs, Managing Directors, Partners, Venture Capitalists, and Elite Founders
- Territory: Nigeria & International Delivery
- Overview: First impressions are tactile. A CHIP NG Metal Card is cool to the touch, noticeably heavy, and beautifully laser-engraved with your custom logo and name. Embedded inside the metal chassis is a high-permeability magnetic ferrite shield that allows NFC signals to pass through flawlessly.
- Key Benefits: 22g Aerospace Stainless Steel (Engineered from solid steel with beveled edges and scratch-resistant physical vapor deposition (PVD) coating.) | Precision Fiber-Laser Engraving (Sharp, permanent laser ablation of your personal name, corporate crest, and handle directly into the metal.) | Patented Dual-Coil Antenna (Proprietary antenna geometry with micro-ferrite shielding ensures fast tap response without metal signal interference.) | VIP WhatsApp Concierge Included (Direct 1-on-1 design assistance from our Lagos production team to review your logo vector proofs before engraving.)
- FAQs:
  - Q: Will the metal card trigger airport metal detectors or damage phones?
    A: No, the card is safe in wallets and bags. It uses standard contactless frequencies that do not damage phone wireless coils or screens.
  - Q: How do I submit my custom logo for metal engraving?
    A: After completing your order, our VIP WhatsApp Concierge (+234 810 076 4154) will reach out to request your high-res logo file and send a digital 3D proof before engraving.
